name: Declared-scale physical readout adapter

statement.note_ascii: conditional unit/scaling adapter: once physical time, observation and state scales are explicitly declared, a certified finite inverse factor K converts sensor/model uncertainty into a physical retained-state radius; a physical epsilon is emitted only if an independently certified tail beta_N in the same state norm is supplied

definitions.T_0: declared physical time scale (for advective scaling, L/U)
definitions.Y_0: declared physical observation scale mapping y_phys=Y_0 y
definitions.X_0: declared physical state scale mapping x_phys=X_0 x
definitions.K: certified nondimensional local inverse factor, e.g. ||A||/(1-q)
definitions.C_ret: declared finite norm adapter from coordinate infinity norm to the retained-state norm
definitions.beta_N: separately certified nondimensional omitted-tail radius in the same state norm used for the outer composition

parents.evidence: PROP-EPSC-39 supplies the finite direct-sample q/data-budget structure and a nondimensional retained coordinate radius
when an independently certified tail beta_N is available in a compatible retained/tail norm, the Pythagorean inner-plus-outer composition is scaled by X_0

claim_boundary: Conditional scaling theorem only. It never invents L, U, T_0, X_0, Y_0, a sensor specification, a retained-norm calibration, physical adequacy of a finite Galerkin cutoff, or a continuum tail certificate. If beta_N is absent or uncertified, the outer physical epsilon verdict is HOLD. It has no Navier-Stokes regularity or Clay implication.
